observations.measurement_context: (1) Thickness of a Film and Coating Layer A contact type thickness measuring device having a precision of 0.1 μm with respect to a thickness is used, and values that three points or more in a TD and ten points or more in a MD are measured with respect to the microporous polyolefin composite film are used. A thickness of the coating layer is measured from a difference between a thickness of the microporous film before the coating and a thickness of the microporous film after the coating. In case of the microporous film of which both surfaces are coated with the coating layer, a half of the difference between the thickness before coating and thickness after the coating is used as the thickness of the microporous film.
observations.notes: Publication US20110033743A1; Example 1; printed unit: μm. Example identity and experimental protocol retained; no processing temperature inferred.

observations.measurement_context: (9) Shutdown Temperature and Meltdown Temperature Shutdown temperature and meltdown temperature of the microporous polyolefin composite film is measured in a simple cell which can measure impedance. In the simple cell, the microporous polyolefin composite film is interposed between two graphite electrodes, and electrolytes is injected. An electrical resistance is measured, while temperature is increased from 25 to 200° C. at a rate of 5° C./min by using an alternating current of 1 kHz. At this time, a temperature in which the electrical resistance is rapidly increased to a few hundreds to a few thousands Ω or more is selected as the closing temperature, and a temperature in which the electrical resistance is again reduced to 100 Ω or less is selected as the meltdown temperature. And the electrolyte in which 1M lithium hexafluorophosphate (LiPF 6 ) is dissolved in a solution that ethylene carbonate and propylene carbonate are mixed in a weight ratio of 1:1 is used.
observations.notes: Publication US20110033743A1; Example 1; printed unit: ° C.. Example identity and experimental protocol retained; no processing temperature inferred.
observations.source_restrictions: License/reuse permission not established; local research evidence only
